about_the_game:
In this game, you must strategically position your allies on the rooftops of the favela to stop enemies from invading and protect your territory. Hold out as long as possible to earn even greater rewards!

Defend your base

  • Use the money you earn to place allies in tactical spots and purchase upgrades. Buy ability cards to make it harder for enemies to advance.

Climb the ranks

  •  Achieve higher scores and rise above other players on the local and global leaderboards.

Face new challenges

  • Try out different maps and test your skills with increasingly difficult levels.

content_descriptors.notes:
Favela Defender features moderate representations of violence involving the use of firearms. During gameplay, enemies may be defeated and their bodies remain visible on the battlefield. However, there is no depiction of blood or realistic graphic detail, as the game uses a pixel art aesthetic with a low level of visual realism.

Recommended for players who are aware of the presence of armed combat and moderate visual consequences within a strategic and stylized context.

short_description: Favela Defender is a tower defense game where you take charge of your own favela and must defend it against invaders. Face challenges across different maps, adapt your strategies, and compete for your spot on the global leaderboard!
